name: INSTAR Lab
title: INSTAR Lab public record
description: A source-conscious index of INSTAR Lab's public identity, research pathways, website structure, media, and evidence boundaries.
evidencePolicy: Repository-backed content is distinguished from claims requiring human or external verification.

routes.label: Record room
routes.title: INSTAR Lab public record
routes.description: A compact, source-conscious index of INSTAR Lab's public identity, research pathways, website structure, media, and evidence boundaries.

routes.label: Leadership
routes.title: Leadership, governance, and affiliations
routes.description: What the public site identifies about INSTAR Lab's institutional leadership and research relationships, with a clear boundary around unpublished personnel records.

routes.label: Legal status
routes.title: Legal status, filings, and the §6104(d) request path
routes.description: The institution's legal identity, exemption classification, and ruling date, each next to the source that carries it, plus the statutory route for requesting the records a tax-exempt organization has to provide.

routes.label: Governance
routes.title: Board and policy register
routes.description: The board seats and the policies a donor or a board member would look for, with each row stating what establishes it and the rows nothing establishes published empty rather than omitted.

routes.label: Affiliations
routes.title: Affiliation register
routes.description: Each partner organization and named person the public site presents, carried with the status of the evidence behind it rather than as a completed table.

routes.label: Positioning profile
routes.title: INSTAR Lab positioning and public claims
routes.description: A readable register of the language, audiences, research domains, and next actions used across the public site.

routes.label: Decision briefs
routes.title: Role-specific paths through the INSTAR site
routes.description: Short routes for program officers, collaborators, researchers, fellows, and supporters who need to decide what to inspect next.

routes.label: Federal record
routes.title: Federal and institutional research posture
routes.description: The public evidence for INSTAR Lab's federal, institutional, sponsored-program, and STTR pathways—without implying an award, contract, or credential that is not published.

routes.label: Source register
routes.title: Source register and verification limits
routes.description: A dated-in-practice register of the repository sources behind this record room, including what is verified, what requires review, and what is not public.

routes.label: Corrections
routes.title: Corrections register
routes.description: The claims this site published and then withdrew, each with what was wrong, what the site says now, the date the correction landed, and the commit that landed it.

routes.label: Documents
routes.title: Public documents and asset register
routes.description: A focused index of public documents, route-backed content, fonts, logos, and image policy records used by the site.

routes.label: Site map
routes.title: INSTAR Lab public site link inventory
routes.description: The complete source-derived route inventory for the current public website, grouped by family and searchable in the browser.

routes.label: Content inventory
routes.title: Captured page inventory: content, media, and metadata
routes.description: Build-time measurements from the route manifests, article collection, and public media policy—not claims about audience traffic or research outcomes.

routes.label: Visual archive
routes.title: See the public site in context
routes.description: Representative source visuals from the public AVIF library, linked back to the pages where readers encounter them. These are source visuals, not screenshot captures.

routes.label: Delivery status
routes.title: Static delivery and operational readiness
routes.description: A public-facing view of the site's delivery model, content ownership boundaries, forms posture, and the checks that protect the static build.

routes.label: Brand guide
routes.title: INSTAR Lab visual system and public assets
routes.description: A compact reference for the current INSTAR visual language: logo, type, palette, spacing, image policy, and accessible interaction principles.
